content.short: Envio is a modern, multi-chain EVM blockchain indexer for real-time and historical data.
content.description: Envio is a customizable, real-time indexing platform for smart contract data across multiple blockchains. It provides automatic code generation, thorough logging and clear error messages, plus quick-start templates and a reliable hosted service. Indexers can be written in JavaScript, TypeScript, or ReScript and natively support multi-chain data aggregation through a unified GraphQL API. Hypersync speeds up data retrieval for popular EVMs with faster APIs than JSON-RPC.
content.meta: Envio is a customizable, real-time indexing solution that indexes smart contract data. Discover Envio and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
